editorial:
Imagine you are a writer who cannot come up with a single new idea, so you hire a psychic to help you get some inspiration. That is exactly where you find yourself with the main character in this flick. It starts off as a quirky little story about a man and his current wife, but things get wild when a seance goes wrong. Suddenly, the man's first wife appears as a ghost, and she is not happy about being dead or seeing him with someone else. The vibe is light, colorful, and feels like a stage play brought to life with a lot of charm.

You will love the chemistry between the actors, especially as the ghost starts causing chaos in the house. The pacing is snappy, and the jokes land well, though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable. It is a great pick if you want something breezy and funny without too much stress. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the bright colors of the set. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for a movie night.
endingExplained: In the end, the chaos reaches a peak as the ghost wife tries to take over the house. However, the main character eventually realizes that his current wife is the one he truly loves. Through a series of funny mishaps and a final confrontation with the medium, the ghost is finally sent back to the afterlife. The couple reconciles, the writer finds his spark again, and they live happily without any supernatural intruders.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a magical twist.
